name: Greek-Style Steak Pita Wrap with Bell Pepper, Cucumber, Onion & Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a large bowl.
Pat steak dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers along with oil and spices; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add peppers and steak. Working in batches if necessary, cook, stirring occasionally, until peppers are soft and steak is cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons.
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds.
Divide pitas between two baking sheet pans. Place in the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.

To assemble, divide steak, peppers, onion, and cucumber between pitas. To make wraps easier to eat, place each pita on a square of parchment paper. Use the paper to tightly roll and secure each wrap. Otherwise, eat as is and get a little messy! Drizzle with yogurt sauce and enjoy!
